name: Wana -Trap-
source:
An artificial mental parasite "Gaist" is invented by the government to provide special abilities to humans. However, an incident happened during testing of the most powerful Gaist "Uroboros" ending up with main character infested. Now he can survive only by insulting women. A special unit of twelve women is dispatched to pacify main character.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
政府发明了一种人工精神寄生虫“Gaist”，旨在为人类提供特殊能力。然而，在测试最强大的盖斯特“Uroboros”时发生了一个事件，导致主角被感染。现在他只能靠侮辱女性来生存。一支由十二名女性组成的特殊部队被派去安抚主角。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
